meta_description: Architecture, security posture and compliance evidence for Achala Compass — Responsible AI & Governance Suite.

blocks.x: How Achala Compass is put together: the register, the validation engine and the monitoring loop that keeps governance current.
Structurally Achala Compass is planes, not layers, workload, decision and evidence run in parallel behind one governed API, and each crossing is logged with policy version and owner.
For Achala Compass architecture, the build decomposes into named pieces, each with an owner and a gate:

items: regime mapping to controls and owners
golden datasets, judge panels, red teams
PII, injection, topic fences as code

blocks.x: For Achala Compass, instrumented from week one, on your channels:

Runtime dependencies: MLflow, evaluation frameworks, guardrail libraries, GRC integration. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Achala Compass follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
Bring one model portfolio to a briefing. We will show the register, the validation workflow and the evidence pack it produces.
